title: The 10 Best Cordless Chainsaws
subtitle: Battery-powered chainsaws for pruning, storm cleanup and firewood, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless chainsaw starts with a trigger, needs no gas or pull cord, and is quiet enough for the neighbors. We ranked 10 best-sellers from EGO, Greenworks, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, WORX, BLACK+DECKER, Husqvarna and SEESII on rating, review volume and features (a 14-inch or longer bar, a battery in the box, a brushless motor, tool-free tensioning and auto oiling). For mini pruning saws, see our mini chainsaw page.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 16" Cordless Chainsaw with 56V 2.5Ah Battery and Charger (CS1611)

specs.extras: Up to 130 cuts on a 4x4, tool-free tension, auto oiling, low-kickback chain

products.verdict: A 16-inch EGO that the maker rates as equal to a 40cc gas saw, with tool-free chain tensioning, automatic oiling and up to 130 cuts on a 4x4 per charge.
products.best_for: Homeowners replacing a small gas saw for storm cleanup and firewood.
products.skip_if: You'll cut all day; get the 4.0Ah CS1613 or a spare battery.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 16" Brushless Cordless Chainsaw with 56V 4.0Ah Battery (CS1613)
products.verdict: The same EGO 16-inch saw with a bigger 4.0Ah battery and a brushless motor, for longer sessions.
products.best_for: Bigger cleanup jobs on one charge.
products.skip_if: You only prune; it's more saw than needed.

products.name: SEESII 12-Inch Brushless Cordless Chainsaw with Two 4.0Ah Batteries (M12 Studio)
products.verdict: A budget 12-inch brushless saw with two 4.0Ah batteries, the cheapest full-size kit here. Its 16,840 reviews are shared across SEESII's chainsaw listings, mostly its mini saws.
products.best_for: Light storm cleanup and limbing on a budget.
products.skip_if: You want reviews for this exact saw; the count is shared with SEESII's mini chainsaws.
cons: Review count shared with other SEESII saws

products.name: SEESII 40V 16-Inch Brushless Cordless Chainsaw with Two 4.0Ah Batteries (M16 Ace)
products.verdict: A 16-inch 40V brushless saw with two 4.0Ah batteries and its own 1,417 reviews, for well under EGO's price.
products.best_for: Firewood and storm cleanup on a budget.
products.skip_if: You want an established brand's dealer support.

products.name: Greenworks 40V 16" Brushless Cordless Chainsaw, 4.0Ah Battery and Charger (20312)
products.verdict: The most-reviewed saw here with its own review count (6,097): a 16-inch brushless Greenworks with a 4.0Ah battery and automatic oiler.
products.best_for: Greenworks 40V owners and anyone wanting a proven 16-inch saw.
products.skip_if: You want tool-free chain tensioning; it isn't listed.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX 12 in. Cordless Chainsaw, Tool Only (DCCS621B)
products.verdict: DEWALT's 12-inch 20V chainsaw, the best seller among the brand-name saws here. The listing is a single line, so check DEWALT's site for specs.
products.best_for: DEWALT 20V owners who want a light saw for limbs and cleanup.
products.skip_if: You want details on the listing; it has almost none.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 12-Inch Cordless Chainsaw with 4.0Ah Battery and Charger (CMCCS620M1)

specs.extras: Bubble level, auto oiling, tool-free tensioning

products.verdict: A CRAFTSMAN kit with a 4.0Ah battery, auto oiling, tool-free tensioning and a bubble level for straight cuts.
products.best_for: CRAFTSMAN V20 owners doing light yard work.

products.name: WORX 20V 10" Cordless Chainsaw with Auto-Tension (WG322)

specs.extras: Automatic chain tension, oil level indicator

products.verdict: A light 6.2 lb WORX saw with automatic chain tensioning, on the Power Share battery that runs WORX's 75+ tools.
products.best_for: Light pruning and small limbs for WORX owners.
products.skip_if: You'll cut firewood; a 10-inch bar is small.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX 10-Inch Cordless Chainsaw, Tool Only (LCS1020B)
products.verdict: A cheap 10-inch saw for BLACK+DECKER 20V owners, with tool-free tensioning and a scabbard. It cuts up to 8 inches.
products.best_for: Pruning and small limbs around the yard.
products.skip_if: You need to cut logs over 8 inches.

products.name: Husqvarna Power Axe 350i 18" Cordless Chainsaw with Battery and Charger (970601202)
products.verdict: Husqvarna's 18-inch battery saw with an X-Cut chain, tool-less tensioning and a brushless motor, which Husqvarna says out-cuts similar gas saws.
products.best_for: Serious firewood cutting from a chainsaw brand.
products.skip_if: You're on a budget; it's the priciest here.

avoid.name: 10 Inch Cordless Chainsaw for DEWALT 20V MAX Battery, 1000W Brushless Handheld Chainsaw with 4.0Ah Battery
avoid.flag: Sold 'for DEWALT' with an unbranded battery; 1,000 W claim
avoid.verdict: A 10-inch saw marketed for DEWALT 20V batteries that ships with its own unbranded 4.0 battery and makes a power claim the listing doesn't support.
reasons: The title says it's for DEWALT 20V MAX batteries, but the box contents list '4.0 Battery *1, Charger *1' with no brand, so you can't tell what you're getting or whether it's safe on a DEWALT charger.
The bullets call it a 'mini cordless chainsaw' while the title calls it a 10-inch chainsaw, a sign the copy was reused from another product.
It claims 1,000 W from a 20V pack and gives no runtime or cuts-per-charge figure. DEWALT's own DCCS621B uses the same batteries with DEWALT's warranty.

buyers_guide.q: What bar length do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 10 to 12 inches handles pruning and limbs up to about 8 inches thick. 14 to 16 inches is the sweet spot for storm cleanup and firewood. 18 inches and up is for bigger trees.

buyers_guide.q: Can a battery saw replace gas?
buyers_guide.a: For most homeowners, yes. EGO rates its 16-inch saws as equal to a 40cc gas saw. Big logs all day still favor gas or a second battery.
EGO lists up to 130 cuts through a 4x4 on its 2.5Ah battery, Greenworks about 50 on 2.0Ah. Bigger batteries cut longer; buy a spare for firewood days.
Keep bar oil topped up (most oil automatically), keep the chain sharp and correctly tensioned. Tool-free tensioning makes adjustments easy.

buyers_guide.q: What safety gear do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Eye and ear protection, cut-resistant chaps, gloves and boots. Never cut above shoulder height, and watch the tip of the bar to avoid kickback.
